addons.name: Extra Life - Revival Life
addons.description:
Don’t let elimination take you out of the game just yet! With the Revival Life, you can re-enter the game after being “tagged” or eliminated. For just $5, you’ll get one Revival Life, which allows you to come back into the competition with a fresh start, but your points will reset to zero when you use it. One Revival Life per player ensures that you have a second chance to fight for the top spot and continue your journey in Comedy Assassins.

Extra Lives are Limited.

Don’t miss out—revive your game and keep going strong!
